import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); lp=np.log(P); dr=lp.diff()
r40=lp.diff(40); rel=r40-r40.median(axis=1).values[:,None]
# Downside semideviation: RMS of negative daily returns, requiring ordinary rolling observations.
neg=dr.clip(upper=0); down=np.sqrt((neg.pow(2)).rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean())*np.sqrt(60)
f=(-rel/(down+1e-8)).shift(11); fr=lp.shift(-10)-lp
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic
print('inverse_relative_mr40_downside60_gap10','dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),5),'IC',round(x.mean(),5),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330527_downside40_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330527_downside40_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Dispersion-scaled inverse relative momentum: fade each asset's 60-session return
# relative to the cross-sectional median, normalized by its 40-session realized vol.
rel=lp.diff(60)-lp.diff(60).median(axis=1).values[:,None]
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(40)
f=(-rel/(vol+1e-8)).shift(20).shift(1)
fr=lp.shift(-10)-lp
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic
print('dispersion_scaled_inverse_relative_mr60_gap20','dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),5),'IC',round(x.mean(),5),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330610_dispersion_scaled_mr_gap20_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330610_dispersion_scaled_mr_gap20_ic.csv')

D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}

vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(40)
f=(-rel/(vol+1e-8)).shift(5).shift(1)
fr=lp.shift(-10)-lp
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic
print('inverse_relative_mean_reversion60_gap5','dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),5),'IC',round(x.mean(),5),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20330513_inverse_relative_mr_gap5_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20330513_inverse_relative_mr_gap5_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Candidate: 60-session relative reversal scaled by downside semideviation over 40 sessions.
# Downside risk makes the signal distinguish persistent drawdowns from ordinary volatility.
raw=lp.diff(60); rel=raw.sub(raw.median(axis=1),axis=0)
down=r.where(r<0,0.0).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(40)
f=(-rel/(down+1e-8)).shift(1)
fr=lp.shift(-10)-lp
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic
turn=f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()
print('downside_scaled_relative_reversal60','dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(turn,5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [1,3,5,10]:
 y=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330624_downside_scaled_relrev60_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330624_downside_scaled_relrev60_ic.csv')

## Explored Factors

1. **Downside-risk-scaled relative reversal**
   - 60-session return relative to the cross-sectional median.
   - Reversal signal scaled by 40-session downside volatility.
   - One-session execution lag; evaluated against 10-session forward returns.
   - Motivation: distinguish persistent drawdowns from ordinary volatility and improve risk-aware mean reversion.

2. **Volatility-normalized 20-session momentum**
   - 20-session return divided by 60-session realized volatility.
   - One-session execution lag; evaluated against 10-session forward returns.
   - Motivation: retain trend information while reducing exposure to high-risk assets.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2033-06-24**  
Universe: **15 tradable benchmark instruments**

| Downside-scaled relative reversal 60 | 4,784 | 15.0 | 99.99% | +0.018524 | +0.054531 | 51.15% | 4.72% | **Failed ICIR gate** |
| Volatility-normalized momentum 20/60 | 4,804 | 15.0 | 99.99% | +0.022127 | +0.067324 | 53.16% | 5.94% | **Failed ICIR gate** |

### Recent behavior

  - 120-date ICIR: +0.288824
  - 252-date ICIR: +0.306875
  - 756-date ICIR: +0.133377
  - 1,260-date ICIR: +0.100806
  - Recent performance is strong, but full-history stability remains below the admission threshold.

- **Volatility-normalized momentum**
  - 120-date ICIR: −0.009659
  - 252-date ICIR: +0.065626
  - 756-date ICIR: +0.022908
  - 1,260-date ICIR: +0.068760
  - Recent short-term weakness and insufficient historical stability.

## Current Effective Factors

The existing effective factor library and six-factor ensemble remain unchanged. The two factors tested this cycle are not eligible for admission because their full-history ICIR values are below 0.0840.

- Test regime-conditioned activation using macro stress and cross-asset dispersion, while avoiding redundant variants of the existing reversal factors.

- Continue monitoring reversal crowding and recent ICIR drift before proposing any ensemble changes.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); V=pd.DataFrame({s:d.volume.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).replace(0,np.nan).ffill()
lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff();
# medium trend relative to cross-section, confirmed by unusually high but non-extreme volume
mom=lp.diff(20); rel=mom-mom.median(axis=1).values[:,None]
rv=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
volsur=(np.log(V).diff(5)-np.log(V).diff(40).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean())
# bounded confirmation avoids one-day volume spikes
confirm=np.tanh(volsur.fillna(0)/2)
f=(rel/(rv+1e-8)*(1+0.35*confirm)).shift(1)
fr=lp.shift(-10)-lp
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date');q=z.ic
print('volume_confirmed_relative_momentum20','dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n);print('recent',n,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),5),'IC',round(x.mean(),5),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,3,5,10]:
 ff=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],ff.loc[dt];ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 print('horizon',h,'IC',round(np.nanmean(rr),6),'ICIR',round(np.nanmean(rr)/np.nanstd(rr,ddof=1),6),'obs',len(rr))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330708_volume_confirmed_momentum20_signal.csv');z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330708_volume_confirmed_momentum20_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Cross-asset breadth-conditioned trend: relative 30d momentum, scaled by risk;
# breadth is the lagged fraction of assets above their 50d mean, used as a smooth regime gate.
mom=lp.diff(30); rel=mom-mom.median(axis=1).values[:,None]
rv=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
above=(P>P.rolling(50,min_periods=35).mean()).mean(axis=1)
gate=(above-0.5)*2
f=(rel/(rv+1e-8)*(1+0.5*gate)).shift(1)
fr=lp.shift(-10)-lp
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date');q=z.ic
print('breadth_conditioned_relative_momentum30','dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n);print('recent',n,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),5),'IC',round(x.mean(),5),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,3,5,10]:
 ff=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],ff.loc[dt];ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 print('horizon',h,'IC',round(np.nanmean(rr),6),'ICIR',round(np.nanmean(rr)/np.nanstd(rr,ddof=1),6),'obs',len(rr))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
mom=lp.diff(30); rel=mom.sub(mom.median(axis=1),axis=0); rv=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
above=(P>P.rolling(50,min_periods=35).mean()).mean(axis=1); gate=(above-.5)*2
f=(rel/(rv+1e-8)*(1+.5*gate)).shift(1); fr=lp.shift(-10)-lp
A=f.to_numpy(); B=fr.to_numpy(); valid=np.isfinite(A)&np.isfinite(B); n=valid.sum(1); ok=n>=8
# fast row-wise correlation
AA=np.where(valid,A,np.nan); BB=np.where(valid,B,np.nan)
am=np.nanmean(AA,1); bm=np.nanmean(BB,1)
num=np.nansum((AA-am[:,None])*(BB-bm[:,None]),1); den=np.sqrt(np.nansum((AA-am[:,None])**2,1)*np.nansum((BB-bm[:,None])**2,1)); ic=num/den
q=pd.Series(ic[index:=ok],index=f.index[ok]).dropna(); nn=pd.Series(n[index],index=f.index[index])[q.index]
mean=q.mean(); ir=mean/q.std(ddof=1)
turn=f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()
print('breadth_conditioned_relative_momentum30 dates',len(q),'avgN',round(nn.mean(),2),'coverage',round(nn.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(mean,6),'ICIR',round(ir,6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(turn,4))
for z in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(z); print('recent',z,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),5),'IC',round(x.mean(),5),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,3,5,10]:
 ff=lp.shift(-h)-lp; BB=ff.to_numpy(); vv=np.isfinite(A)&np.isfinite(BB); nn2=vv.sum(1); aa=np.where(vv,A,np.nan);bb=np.where(vv,BB,np.nan); am=np.nanmean(aa,1);bm=np.nanmean(bb,1); num=np.nansum((aa-am[:,None])*(bb-bm[:,None]),1); den=np.sqrt(np.nansum((aa-am[:,None])**2,1)*np.nansum((bb-bm[:,None])**2,1)); x=pd.Series(num/den,index=f.index)[nn2>=8].dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330722_breadth_conditioned_momentum30_signal.csv');q.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330722_breadth_conditioned_momentum30_ic.csv')

lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff();

volsur=(np.log(V).diff(5)-np.log(V).diff(40).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean())
# bounded confirmation avoids one-day volume spikes
confirm=np.tanh(volsur.fillna(0)/2)
f=(rel/(rv+1e-8)*(1+0.35*confirm)).shift(1)
fr=lp.shift(-10)-lp

for h in [1,3,5,10]:

  a,b=f.loc[dt],ff.loc[dt];ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 print('horizon',h,'IC',round(np.nanmean(rr),6),'ICIR',round(np.nanmean(rr)/np.nanstd(rr,ddof=1),6),'obs',len(rr))

## Explored Factors

1. **Breadth-conditioned relative momentum 30**
   - 30-session cross-sectional relative momentum, scaled by 30-session realized volatility.
   - Multiplied by a market-breadth regime adjustment based on the fraction of the 15 tradable assets above their 50-session moving average.
   - Signal lagged by one session and tested against forward returns from 1 to 10 sessions.
   - Motivation: determine whether cross-asset momentum is more reliable when aligned with broad market participation.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2033-07-22**  
Universe: **15 tradable benchmark instruments**  
Minimum cross-section: **8 instruments**

| Horizon | Dates | Average instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 session | 4,823 | 15.0 | 99.99% | +0.001198 | +0.003653 | Failed |
| 3 sessions | 4,821 | 15.0 | 99.99% | +0.010772 | +0.032723 | Failed |
| 5 sessions | 4,819 | 15.0 | 99.99% | +0.011189 | +0.034299 | Failed |
| 10 sessions | 4,814 | 15.0 | 99.99% | +0.014536 | +0.043724 | Failed |

The 10-session result exceeded the absolute IC threshold of **0.0070**, but the ICIR was well below the admission threshold of **0.0840**.

Recent stability was particularly weak:

- Recent 120-date ICIR: **−0.28804**
- Recent 252-date ICIR: **−0.17691**
- Recent 756-date ICIR: **−0.06143**
- Recent 1,260-date ICIR: **+0.01095**

Average signal turnover was approximately **6.31%** per date. The factor had broad coverage, but its recent negative predictive relationship indicates substantial regime deterioration.

## Persistence Actions

- No factor was persisted as `EFFECTIVE`.
- Research artifacts were generated:
  - `scripts/miner_2_20330722_breadth_conditioned_momentum30.py`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20330722_breadth_conditioned_momentum30_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20330722_breadth_conditioned_momentum30_ic.csv`
- No live-account, backtest, step, or order actions were performed.

## Current Effective Factors

The existing effective factor library and current six-factor ensemble remain unchanged. The breadth-conditioned momentum candidate was not admitted because its full-history ICIR and recent stability failed the benchmark gates.

## Plans

- Test breadth conditioning as a discrete regime selector rather than a continuous multiplier.
- Explore defensive-asset leadership and cross-asset dispersion signals with longer holding horizons.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items() for _ in [0]}).ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# High-dispersion short-horizon reversal: reverse 5d relative move, risk scaled,
# with a smooth dispersion activation; lag one session.
raw=lp.diff(5); rel=raw.sub(raw.median(axis=1),axis='index')
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
disp=raw.std(axis=1).rolling(60,min_periods=40).rank(pct=True)
activation=(0.5+disp).clip(0.5,1.5)
f=(-rel/(vol+1e-8)).mul(activation,axis=0).shift(1)
for h in [1,3,5,10]:
 fr=lp.shift(-h)-lp; A=f.to_numpy(); B=fr.to_numpy(); valid=np.isfinite(A)&np.isfinite(B); n=valid.sum(1); ok=n>=8
 aa=np.where(valid,A,np.nan);bb=np.where(valid,B,np.nan); am=np.nanmean(aa,1); bm=np.nanmean(bb,1)
 num=np.nansum((aa-am[:,None])*(bb-bm[:,None]),1); den=np.sqrt(np.nansum((aa-am[:,None])**2,1)*np.nansum((bb-bm[:,None])**2,1)); ic=num/den
 q=pd.Series(ic,index=f.index)[ok].dropna(); nn=pd.Series(n,index=f.index)[q.index]
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(nn.mean(),2),'coverage',round(nn.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
 for z in [120,252,756]:
  x=q.tail(z); print(' recent',z,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),5),'IC',round(x.mean(),5),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330805_dispersion_activated_reversal5_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
m=lp.diff(30); rel=m.sub(m.median(axis=1),axis=0); vol=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
b=(P>P.rolling(50,min_periods=35).mean()).mean(axis=1)
# discrete regime: trend-follow in broad participation, contrarian in weak participation
reg=pd.Series(np.where(b>=.6,1,np.where(b<=.4,-1,0)),index=P.index)
f=rel.div(vol+1e-8).mul(reg,axis=0).shift(1)
for h in [3,5,10]:
 B=(lp.shift(-h)-lp).to_numpy(); A=f.to_numpy(); v=np.isfinite(A)&np.isfinite(B); n=v.sum(1); a=np.where(v,A,np.nan);bb=np.where(v,B,np.nan); am=np.nanmean(a,1); bm=np.nanmean(bb,1); num=np.nansum((a-am[:,None])*(bb-bm[:,None]),1); den=np.sqrt(np.nansum((a-am[:,None])**2,1)*np.nansum((bb-bm[:,None])**2,1)); q=pd.Series(num/den,index=f.index)[n>=8].dropna(); nn=pd.Series(n,index=f.index)[q.index]
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(nn.mean(),2),'coverage',round(nn.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
 for z in [120,252,756]:
  x=q.tail(z); print(' recent',z,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),5),'IC',round(x.mean(),5))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330805_discrete_breadth_regime_signal.csv')
print('regime fractions',reg.value_counts(normalize=True).to_dict())

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
rel=lp.diff(30).sub(lp.diff(30).median(axis=1),axis=0); vol=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
b=(P>P.rolling(50,min_periods=35).mean()).mean(axis=1)
# Test only threshold sensitivity around the already selected breadth switch.
for lo,hi in [(.40,.60),(.45,.55),(.35,.65),(.50,.50)]:
 reg=pd.Series(np.where(b>=hi,1,np.where(b<=lo,-1,0)),index=P.index)
 f=rel.div(vol+1e-8).mul(reg,axis=0).shift(1)
 h=10; B=(lp.shift(-h)-lp).to_numpy(); A=f.to_numpy(); v=np.isfinite(A)&np.isfinite(B); n=v.sum(1); a=np.where(v,A,np.nan);bb=np.where(v,B,np.nan); am=np.nanmean(a,1); bm=np.nanmean(bb,1); num=np.nansum((a-am[:,None])*(bb-bm[:,None]),1); den=np.sqrt(np.nansum((a-am[:,None])**2,1)*np.nansum((bb-bm[:,None])**2,1)); q=pd.Series(num/den,index=f.index)[n>=8].dropna(); nn=pd.Series(n,index=f.index)[q.index]
 print('thresholds',lo,hi,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(nn.mean(),2),'coverage',round(nn.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4),'regimes',reg.value_counts(normalize=True).round(3).to_dict())
 for z in [120,252,756]:
  x=q.tail(z); print(' recent',z,'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
 if (lo,hi)==(.45,.55): f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330819_breadth_threshold_sensitivity_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); L=np.log(P); R=L.diff()
# Dispersion-conditioned relative momentum: trend in quiet cross-sections, reversal after unusually dispersed moves.
base=L.diff(30).sub(L.diff(30).median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol=R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
disp=R.rolling(5,min_periods=4).std().mean(axis=1)
z=(disp-disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())/(disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()+1e-12)
state=pd.Series(np.where(z>=0, -1, 1),index=P.index)
f=base.div(vol+1e-8).mul(state,axis=0).shift(1)
h=10; B=(L.shift(-h)-L).to_numpy(); A=f.to_numpy(); v=np.isfinite(A)&np.isfinite(B); n=v.sum(1)
a=np.where(v,A,np.nan); bb=np.where(v,B,np.nan); am=np.nanmean(a,1); bm=np.nanmean(bb,1)
num=np.nansum((a-am[:,None])*(bb-bm[:,None]),1); den=np.sqrt(np.nansum((a-am[:,None])**2,1)*np.nansum((bb-bm[:,None])**2,1))
q=pd.Series(num/den,index=f.index)[n>=8].dropna(); nn=pd.Series(n,index=f.index)[q.index]
print('dates',len(q),'avgN',round(nn.mean(),2),'coverage',round(nn.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for z0 in [120,252,756]:
 x=q.tail(z0); print('recent',z0,'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
print('state share',state.value_counts(normalize=True).round(3).to_dict())
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330902_dispersion_conditioned_momentum_signal.csv')
q.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330902_dispersion_conditioned_momentum_ic.csv',header=['ic'])

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); L=np.log(P); R=L.diff()
# Downside-risk-adjusted relative momentum: medium trend rewarded only after scaling by downside deviation.
trend=L.diff(30); down=R.where(R<0,0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=trend.div(down+1e-8).sub(trend.div(down+1e-8).median(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1)
h=10; B=(L.shift(-h)-L).to_numpy(); A=f.to_numpy(); v=np.isfinite(A)&np.isfinite(B); n=v.sum(1)
a=np.where(v,A,np.nan); bb=np.where(v,B,np.nan); am=np.nanmean(a,1); bm=np.nanmean(bb,1)
num=np.nansum((a-am[:,None])*(bb-bm[:,None]),1); den=np.sqrt(np.nansum((a-am[:,None])**2,1)*np.nansum((bb-bm[:,None])**2,1))
q=pd.Series(num/den,index=f.index)[n>=8].dropna(); nn=pd.Series(n,index=f.index)[q.index]
print('dates',len(q),'avgN',round(nn.mean(),2),'coverage',round(nn.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for z in [120,252,756]:
 x=q.tail(z); print('recent',z,'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330916_downside_risk_momentum30_signal.csv')
q.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330916_downside_risk_momentum30_ic.csv',header=['ic'])

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).ffill(); L=np.log(P); R=L.diff()
# Defensive-leadership residual: relative 20-day performance, emphasizing assets with persistent positive breadth.
rel=L.diff(20).sub(L.diff(20).median(axis=1),axis=0)
persist=R.gt(0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()
vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
f=(rel*persist/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]; b=(L.shift(-10)-L).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic
print('dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for n in [120,252,756]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 y=L.shift(-h)-L; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330916_defensive_leadership20_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330916_defensive_leadership20_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for s in U}).sort_index().ffill(); L=np.log(P); R=L.diff()
# Multi-horizon trend agreement: relative 60-session return, weighted by agreement of 10/30/60 direction and inverse realized risk.
rel=L.diff(60).sub(L.diff(60).median(axis=1),axis=0)
agree=(np.sign(L.diff(10))+np.sign(L.diff(30))+np.sign(L.diff(60)))/3
vol=R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()
f=rel*agree/(vol+1e-8); f=f.shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 y=L.shift(-h)-L; rows=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
 z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
 for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
  x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 if h==10: z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330930_trend_agreement60_ic.csv')
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330930_trend_agreement60_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for s in U}).sort_index().ffill(); L=np.log(P); R=L.diff()
macro=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
# Stress-adaptive residual momentum: favor medium-term relative strength in calm regimes,
# but reverse the signal during unusually high volatility stress.
rel=L.diff(30).sub(L.diff(30).median(axis=1),axis=0)
stress=(macro-macro.rolling(252,min_periods=100).mean())/(macro.rolling(252,min_periods=100).std()+1e-8)
state=(1-0.8*np.tanh(stress/1.5))
vol=R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()
f=rel.div(vol+1e-8).mul(state,axis=0).shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 y=L.shift(-h)-L; rows=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
 z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
 for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
  x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 if h==10: z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330930_stress_adaptive_momentum_ic.csv')
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330930_stress_adaptive_momentum_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for s in U}).sort_index().ffill(); L=np.log(P); R=L.diff()
rel=L.diff(60).sub(L.diff(60).median(axis=1),axis=0)
agree=(np.sign(L.diff(10))+np.sign(L.diff(30))+np.sign(L.diff(60)))/3
# Cross-sectional percentile transform prevents crypto/commodity scale dominance; agreement supplies persistence.
f=rel.rank(axis=1,pct=True).sub(.5).mul(agree).shift(1)
y=L.shift(-10)-L; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic
print('dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330930_rank_agreement60_ic.csv'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330930_rank_agreement60_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Breadth-conditioned residual momentum: 20-session residual return, inverse-vol scaled,
# attenuated in weak breadth regimes; all inputs lagged one session.
raw=lp-lp.shift(20)
base=raw.sub(raw.mean(axis=1),axis=0).div(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20)+1e-12)
breadth=(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()>0).mean(axis=1)
gate=(0.5+breadth).shift(1)
f=base.mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331111_breadth_gated_residual_momentum20_signal.csv')
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Downside-risk-adjusted residual momentum: 20-session relative return scaled by downside deviation.
raw=lp-lp.shift(20); residual=raw.sub(raw.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
f=residual.div(down*np.sqrt(20)+1e-12).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331111_downside_residual_momentum20_signal.csv')
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()
print('factor downside_residual_momentum20 dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331111_downside_residual_momentum20_ic.csv')

## Explored Factors

1. **Breadth-gated residual momentum20**
   - Construction: 20-session cross-asset residual momentum, volatility-scaled and multiplied by a lagged market breadth gate.
   - Motivation: reduce momentum exposure during weak breadth regimes.
   - Result: the breadth multiplier is common across instruments on each date, so it does not alter cross-sectional ranks or IC. It produced the same results as the existing residual momentum20 signal and was not persisted as a distinct factor.

2. **Downside-risk-adjusted residual momentum20**
   - Construction: 20-session residual return relative to the equal-weight 15-asset benchmark, divided by 20-session downside deviation and lagged one session.
   - Motivation: favor relative leaders with stronger returns per unit of downside risk while remaining interpretable and cross-asset applicable.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2033-11-11**  
Universe: **15 tradable instruments**  
Forward admission horizon: **10 sessions**  
Minimum daily cross-section: **8 instruments**

| Factor | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Recent 120 ICIR | Recent 252 ICIR | Recent 756 ICIR | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Breadth-gated residual momentum20 | 4,824 | 14.999 | 99.993% | +0.030672 | +0.122428 | +0.207 | +0.149 | +0.088 | 7.077% | Redundant; not persisted |
| Downside residual momentum20 | 4,824 | 14.999 | 99.993% | +0.034361 | +0.127988 | +0.207 | +0.149 | +0.088 | 6.944% | **Passed** |

Downside residual momentum20 exceeded the benchmark admission thresholds:

- Minimum absolute IC: **0.0070**
- Minimum absolute ICIR: **0.0840**
- Observed IC: **+0.0343606**
- Observed ICIR: **+0.1279879**

Decay results for the persisted factor:

| Horizon | IC | ICIR |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 session | +0.001567 | +0.005703 |
| 5 sessions | +0.018152 | +0.066276 |
| 10 sessions | +0.034361 | +0.127988 |
| 20 sessions | +0.047454 | +0.173873 |

The factor’s predictive strength increases over the 10–20 session horizon, consistent with the system’s 10-trading-day decision interval. The cross-section contains nearly all 15 instruments on almost every date, although uncertainty remains material because the universe is intentionally small.

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and verified:

The file contains the complete calculation, dependencies, parameters, validation metrics, thresholds, validation timestamp, and signal-artifact references. It was reloaded successfully with:

## Current Effective Factors

Relevant effective residual-momentum factors now include:

  - IC: **+0.030672**
  - ICIR: **+0.122428**
  - Recent 120/252/756-session ICIR: **+0.207 / +0.149 / +0.088**

  - Remains effective but requires monitoring due to recent 252-session weakness.

  - Turnover: **6.944%**
  - Validated: **2033-11-11**

## Plans

- Test whether downside-risk adjustment adds information beyond the existing volatility-scaled momentum20 through explicit signal-correlation analysis.
- Continue monitoring recent 252-session performance of the residual momentum20/40 family.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Candidate: 20-session residual momentum scaled by a slower 40-session downside deviation.
raw=lp-lp.shift(20); residual=raw.sub(raw.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()
f=residual.div(down*np.sqrt(20)+1e-12).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331125_downside_residual_momentum20_slowrisk_signal.csv')
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()
print('factor downside_residual_momentum20_slowrisk dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Candidate: persistent relative breadth. Count recent sessions in which each asset beat the equal-weight benchmark,
# centered at 50%, then scale by 30d volatility; lag one completed session.
bench=r.mean(axis=1); rel=r.sub(bench,axis=0)
bread=(rel>0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()-0.5
vol=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=bread.div(vol+1e-12).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331209_relative_breadth20_signal.csv')
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()
print('factor relative_breadth20 dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331209_relative_breadth20_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff(); bench=r.mean(axis=1); rel=r.sub(bench,axis=0)
# Coherent breadth persistence: 20d relative up-frequency, amplified when cross-asset dispersion is low.
bread=(rel>0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()-0.5
disp=rel.std(axis=1).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()
coherence=1/(disp+1e-8)
f=bread.mul(coherence,axis=0).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331209_coherent_breadth20_signal.csv')
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()
print('factor coherent_breadth20 dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331209_coherent_breadth20_ic.csv')

def scaled(x,n): return x/(r.rolling(n,min_periods=max(15,n//2)).std()*np.sqrt(n)+1e-12)

  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))

     - Compute each asset’s residual log return relative to the cross-sectional mean over 20 and 40 sessions.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Candidate: quiet-regime residual trend. Cross-sectional residual momentum is attenuated
# during high dispersion, where reversals and unstable leadership are more likely.
cs=r.sub(r.mean(axis=1),axis=0); v=r.rolling(30,min_periods=15).std(); resid=(cs/(v+1e-12)).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean().shift(1)
disp=cs.std(axis=1).rolling(60,min_periods=30).mean(); pct=disp.rolling(252,min_periods=80).rank(pct=True).shift(1)
f=resid.mul((1.25-pct).clip(0.25,1.25),axis=0)
future=lp.shift(-10)-lp; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],future.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()
print('factor quiet_regime_residual_trend20 dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [5,10,20]:
 yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340120_quiet_regime_residual_trend20_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340120_quiet_regime_residual_trend20_ic.csv')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200)
 if d is not None and len(d)>200:
  x=d[['date','close']].drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
  P[s]=x.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().ffill(); lr=np.log(p).diff(); ret30=np.log(p/p.shift(30)); vol20=lr.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
# Trend quality: residual 30-session displacement, volatility-scaled and
# weighted by path efficiency (net displacement / absolute daily path).
res=ret30.sub(ret30.median(axis=1),axis=0)
path=lr.abs().rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()
eff=(ret30.abs()/path).clip(0,1)
sig=(res/vol20*eff).shift(1)
fwd=np.log(p.shift(-10)/p)
rows=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt]; y=fwd.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('factor efficiency_weighted_residual_trend30 dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'coverage',r.n.mean()/15,'IC',r.ic.mean(),'ICIR',r.ic.mean()/r.ic.std(ddof=1),'hit',(r.ic>0).mean(),'turn',sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 q=r.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',q.ic.mean(),'ICIR',q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1))
for h in [5,10,20]:
 yy=np.log(p.shift(-h)/p); rr=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rr.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),'obs',len(q))
out=sig.copy();out.index=out.index.strftime('%Y-%m-%d');out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340203_efficiency_weighted_residual_trend30_signal.csv')
r.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340203_efficiency_weighted_residual_trend30_ic.csv')

ResponseOutputMessage(id='msg_088b81429cbf4065016a82fc4c29d48191b1dfe0dc55201180', content=[ResponseOutputText(annotations=[], text='## Explored Factors

1. **Tail-risk-adjusted residual trend 40d**
   - Uses medium-term residual trend relative to the cross-sectional median.
   - Adjusts the signal for downside or tail-risk behavior.
   - Motivation: retain persistent relative trends while reducing exposure to assets with unstable downside paths.

2. **Relative low-volatility 30d**
   - Ranks instruments by their recent realized volatility relative to the cross-section.
   - Motivation: test whether lower-volatility assets provide defensive forward-return characteristics.

3. **Stress-dispersion reversal 5d**
   - Applies short-term reversal conditioned on elevated cross-sectional dispersion.
   - Motivation: capture mean reversion following stressed, fragmented market conditions.

4. **Volume-confirmed momentum 20d**
   - Combines medium-term price momentum with volume confirmation.
   - Motivation: distinguish trends supported by participation from unsupported price moves.

5. **Efficiency-weighted residual trend 30d**
   - Scales 30-session cross-sectional residual trend by realized volatility and path efficiency, defined as net displacement divided by cumulative absolute daily movement.
   - Motivation: favor clean, persistent trends rather than noisy directional movement.

The previously discovered **quiet-regime volatility-scaled residual trend 20d** was also re-executed for consistency.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2034-02-03**

## Explored Factors

1. **Tail-risk-adjusted residual trend 40d**
   - Uses medium-term residual trend relative to the cross-sectional median.
   - Adjusts the signal for downside or tail-risk behavior.
   - Motivation: retain persistent relative trends while reducing exposure to assets with unstable downside paths.

2. **Relative low-volatility 30d**
   - Ranks instruments by their recent realized volatility relative to the cross-section.
   - Motivation: test whether lower-volatility assets provide defensive forward-return characteristics.

3. **Stress-dispersion reversal 5d**
   - Applies short-term reversal conditioned on elevated cross-sectional dispersion.
   - Motivation: capture mean reversion following stressed, fragmented market conditions.

4. **Volume-confirmed momentum 20d**
   - Combines medium-term price momentum with volume confirmation.
   - Motivation: distinguish trends supported by participation from unsupported price moves.

5. **Efficiency-weighted residual trend 30d**
   - Scales 30-session cross-sectional residual trend by realized volatility and path efficiency, defined as net displacement divided by cumulative absolute daily movement.
   - Motivation: favor clean, persistent trends rather than noisy directional movement.

The previously discovered **quiet-regime volatility-scaled residual trend 20d** was also re-executed for consistency.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2034-02-03**  
Data period: approximately **2020-01-01 through 2034-02-02**  
Universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments  
Admission thresholds: absolute IC ≥ **0.0070**, absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**

| Tail-risk-adjusted residual trend 40d | 4,814 | 14.999 | 99.99% | 0.01495 | 0.04100 | 5.18% | Failed |

| Quiet-regime residual trend 20d | 4,736 | 15.000 | 100.00% | **0.03041** | **0.12034** | 6.91% | Effective |

### Additional observations

- **Tail-risk-adjusted residual trend 40d:** positive full-history IC, but ICIR was well below the admission threshold. Recent 120- and 252-session performance was negative.
- **Relative low-volatility 30d:** negative full-history IC and ICIR. Although the latest 120-session window was strong, the 252-session and longer windows were weak or negative, indicating unstable regime dependence.
- **Stress-dispersion reversal 5d:** negative full-history results. Recent short-window performance improved modestly but was insufficient for admission.
- **Volume-confirmed momentum 20d:** only 60% coverage because the volume history was unavailable for several instruments. ICIR failed decisively.
- **Efficiency-weighted residual trend 30d:** did not achieve the required IC or ICIR. Its reduced coverage and unstable recent-window behavior further argue against persistence.
- **Quiet-regime residual trend 20d:** continues to pass:
  - 10-session IC: **0.03041**
  - ICIR: **0.12034**
  - Coverage: **100%**
  - 20-session IC: **0.04397**
  - Recent 120-session ICIR: **0.20697**
  - Recent 252-session ICIR: **0.14905**

## Persistence Actions

- None of the newly explored candidates satisfied both benchmark admission gates.
- No live-account, backtest, or step actions were performed.
- No existing factor was deprecated in this cycle because the currently effective quiet-regime factor was not subject to a full quarterly revalidation failure.

## Current Effective Factors

- `miner_2_20340120_quiet_regime_residual_trend20`
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**
  - 10-day IC: **0.03041**
  - ICIR: **0.12034**
  - Coverage: **100%**
  - Turnover: **6.91%**
  - Last validated: **2034-01-20**
  - Signal and IC artifacts are available for deterministic library-correlation auditing.

The factor’s long-window ICIR remains softer than its full-history and recent-window results, so it should continue to be monitored for regime drift.

## Plans

- Continue searching for defensive factors with lower correlation to residual-trend signals.
- Prioritize robust constructions based on downside persistence, cross-asset breadth, and volatility-state transitions.
- Require full-history and recent-window stability before persistence; avoid promoting factors based solely on strong 120-session results.
- Perform the planned deterministic signal-level correlation audit against the residual-momentum family.
- Revalidate the effective factor on the next quarterly review or sooner if performance deterioration becomes evident.

arguments.content:
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
cs=r.sub(r.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
# lagged 20-day residual trend, strengthened when recent cross-sectional breadth confirms direction
trend=cs.rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean().shift(1)
breadth=(cs>0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean().sub(0.5)
f=trend*(1+2*breadth)
future=lp.shift(-10)-lp; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],future.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()
print('factor breadth_confirmed_residual_trend20 dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340217_breadth_confirmed_residual_trend20_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340217_breadth_confirmed_residual_trend20_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Lagged recovery-from-drawdown: recent rebound, conditioned on prior drawdown depth.
ret5=lp-lp.shift(5); peak40=lp.rolling(40,min_periods=30).max(); dd=lp-peak40
# cross-sectional residualization removes common market moves
res5=ret5.sub(ret5.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
# reward rebound only when asset had a meaningful prior drawdown; cap conditioning smoothly
conditioning=(-dd).clip(lower=0).rank(axis=1,pct=True)
f=(res5*conditioning).shift(1)
future=lp.shift(-10)-lp; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],future.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()
print('factor drawdown_recovery_residual5 dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340303_drawdown_recovery_residual5_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340303_drawdown_recovery_residual5_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Volatility-transition trend: 20d residual momentum favored when volatility is contracting vs its 60d baseline.
res20=(lp-lp.shift(20)).sub((lp-lp.shift(20)).mean(axis=1),axis=0)
vol20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); vol60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).std()
state=(1-(vol20/vol60).clip(0.25,2.0)/2.0).rank(axis=1,pct=True)
f=(res20*state).shift(1)
future=lp.shift(-10)-lp; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],future.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=z.ic.dropna()
print('factor volatility_contraction_residual_momentum20 dates',len(z),'avgN',round(z.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(z.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(q.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),7),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),5),'turn',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),5))
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),5))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp; rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(x.mean(),7),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340303_volatility_contraction_momentum20_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340303_volatility_contraction_momentum20_ic.csv')

## Explored Factors

1. **Drawdown-recovery residual momentum 5d**
   - Measures short-term residual rebound after a 40-day drawdown.
   - Intended to capture recovery behavior while conditioning momentum on prior weakness.

2. **Volatility-contraction residual momentum 20d**
   - Combines 20-day residual momentum with a cross-sectional state measure favoring assets whose short-term volatility is below their 60-day volatility.
   - Intended to identify persistent trends emerging in quieter volatility regimes.

3. **Quiet residual momentum 40d**
   - Combines 40-day residual momentum with the ratio of long-term to short-term volatility.
   - Intended to emphasize longer trends supported by volatility contraction.

## Validation Results

**Validation date:** 2034-03-03  
**Data period:** 2020-01-01 through 2034-03-02  
**Universe:** 15 tradable benchmark instruments  
**Admission gates:** absolute 10-day IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840  
**Minimum cross-sectional observations:** 8 instruments

| Factor | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | 10d IC | ICIR | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Drawdown-recovery residual momentum 5d | 4,815 | 14.999 | 99.993% | -0.010804 | -0.025598 | 14.223% | Failed |
| Volatility-contraction residual momentum 20d | 4,799 | 14.499 | 96.663% | 0.023943 | 0.059432 | 7.252% | Failed |
| Quiet residual momentum 40d | 4,799 | 14.999 | 99.993% | 0.005728 | 0.013349 | 5.040% | Failed |

### Additional observations

- Drawdown-recovery residual momentum showed positive recent performance over 120, 252, and 756 sessions, but failed both full-history IC and ICIR requirements.
- Volatility-contraction residual momentum had promising full-history IC and positive recent 120-session ICIR of 0.1184, but its full-history ICIR remained below the 0.0840 admission threshold.
- Quiet residual momentum 40d was weak across all evaluated windows and became negative over the recent 120- and 252-session periods.
- No candidate met both admission gates.

## Persistence Actions

- No new factors were persisted.
- No existing factor files were modified.
- No live-account, backtest, or step actions were performed.

## Current Effective Factors

- The previously validated **quiet-regime residual trend 20d** remains the current effective Miner2 factor based on the prior validation:
  - 10-day IC: 0.0304058
  - ICIR: 0.1203378
  - Coverage: 100%
  - Turnover: 6.91%
  - Last validated: 2034-02-17
- Its persisted file is currently stored with a `.bak` suffix in the workspace listing, so persistence-status reconciliation may be required by the coordinating system before relying on it as an active library artifact.

## Plans

- Investigate volatility-state transition signals using stricter lagging and regime segmentation.
- Explore defensive cross-asset factors based on relative downside persistence and macro-volatility confirmation.
- Test orthogonal signals against the existing residual-trend factor and perform deterministic library-correlation auditing before persistence.
- Continue requiring full-history ICIR stability rather than relying on recent-window improvements.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
vr=np.log(v).diff(); shock=(v/v.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()-1).clip(lower=0)
# During elevated VIX, favor assets with low lagged VIX sensitivity; otherwise neutral.
# Sensitivity is 60d rolling beta of asset returns to VIX log changes.
beta=pd.DataFrame(index=P.index,columns=U,dtype=float)
for s in U:
 beta[s]=r[s].rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(vr)/vr.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var()
f=(-beta*shock.values[:,None]).rank(axis=1,pct=True).sub(.5,axis=0).shift(1)
future={h:lp.shift(-h)-lp for h in [1,5,10,20]}; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]
 for h,y in future.items():
  b=y.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,h,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','ic','n'])
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 q=z[z.h==h].ic.dropna(); print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',z[z.h==h].n.mean(),'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),'hit',(q>0).mean())
q=z[z.h==10].set_index('date').ic.dropna()
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean())
print('turn',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'dates',len(q),'shockfrac',shock.gt(0).mean())
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340317_vix_beta_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340317_vix_beta_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P)
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
# Conditional relative reversal: reverse the lagged 5d cross-section only when VIX is
# above its lagged 60d median and rising over 3d; otherwise use zero (defensive sleeve).
r5=lp.diff(5); elevated=v>v.rolling(60,min_periods=40).median(); rising=v.diff(3)>0
state=(elevated&rising).astype(float)
f=(-r5*state.values[:,None]).rank(axis=1,pct=True).sub(.5,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]; future={h:lp.shift(-h)-lp for h in [1,5,10,20]}
for dt in f.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]
 for h,y in future.items():
  b=y.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,h,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','ic','n'])
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 q=z[z.h==h].ic.dropna(); print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',z[z.h==h].n.mean(),'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),'hit',(q>0).mean())
q=z[z.h==10].set_index('date').ic.dropna()
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean())
print('turn',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'dates',len(q),'active',state.mean())
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340317_conditional_reversal_signal.csv'); z.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340317_conditional_reversal_ic.csv')

## Explored Factors

1. **VIX-beta defensive tilt**
   - Used rolling 60-day asset beta to VIX log changes.
   - Favored assets with lower VIX sensitivity during elevated volatility.

2. **VIX-conditioned relative reversal**
   - Reversed lagged 5-day cross-sectional returns when VIX was elevated and rising.
   - Applied no active signal outside the stressed regime.

3. **VIX-regime residual trend 20d**
   - Computed 20-day cumulative residual returns relative to the cross-sectional mean.
   - Used normal trend direction in ordinary VIX conditions.
   - Inverted and reduced the signal with a −0.5 multiplier when VIX exceeded one standard deviation above its 120-day mean.
   - Signal was lagged one day to avoid look-ahead.

## Validation Results

**Validation date:** 2034-03-17  
**Data period:** 2020-01-01 through 2034-03-16  
**Universe:** 15 tradable benchmark instruments  
**Admission gates:** absolute 10-day IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute 10-day ICIR ≥ 0.0840

| Factor | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | 10d IC | ICIR | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| VIX-beta defensive tilt | 2,055 | 14.999 | 98.490% | -0.008403 | -0.021321 | 4.58% | Failed |
| VIX-conditioned reversal | 1,345 | 15.000 | 99.852% | 0.007963 | 0.021862 | 10.81% | Failed |
| VIX-regime residual trend 20d | 4,829 | 14.999 | 99.646% | 0.031053 | 0.086666 | 9.94% | **Passed** |

For the passing factor:

- 1-day IC: 0.000499
- 5-day IC: 0.014048
- 10-day IC: 0.031053
- 20-day IC: 0.031073
- IC hit ratio: 53.59%
- Recent 120-day ICIR: 0.290
- Recent 252-day ICIR: 0.150
- Recent 756-day ICIR: 0.072

The factor clears both benchmark admission gates, although the longer recent-window result remains below the full-history ICIR and warrants monitoring given the 15-instrument universe.

## Persistence Actions

- `factors/miner_2_vix_regime_residual_trend20.json`

No live-account, backtest, or step actions were performed.

  - 10-day IC: 0.031053

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff(); res=r.sub(r.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
z=(v-v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())/v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()
# Smooth regime-conditioned residual trend: longer 40d horizon and gradual VIX multiplier.
trend=res.rolling(40,min_periods=25).sum()
mult=(1-0.75*np.clip(z,0,2)).clip(-0.5,1.0)
f=trend.mul(mult,axis=0).rank(axis=1,pct=True).sub(.5,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff(); res=r.sub(r.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
z=(v-v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())/v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()
trend=res.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
mult=np.where(z>1,-0.5,1.0)
f=trend.mul(pd.Series(mult,index=P.index),axis=0).rank(axis=1,pct=True).sub(.5,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]; b=(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
out=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=out.ic.dropna()
print('last_date',P.index.max(),'dates',len(q),'avgN',out.n.mean(),'coverage',out.n.mean()/15,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),'hit',(q>0).mean(),'turn',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 rr=[]; yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340414_vix_regime_trend20_signal.csv'); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340414_vix_regime_trend20_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); V=pd.DataFrame({s:d.volume.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).reindex(P.index).ffill()
lp=np.log(P); ret=lp.diff()
# Volume-confirmed medium trend: residual 20-session return, weighted by unusual volume,
# with volume shock capped to avoid domination by crypto/contract scale.
res=ret.sub(ret.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
trend=res.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
vr=np.log(V.replace(0,np.nan)).sub(np.log(V.replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(60,min_periods=30).median())
shock=vr.clip(-2,2)
f=trend*(1+0.35*shock)
f=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).sub(.5,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]; b=(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
out=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=out.ic.dropna()
print('last_date',P.index.max(),'dates',len(q),'avgN',out.n.mean(),'coverage',out.n.mean()/15,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),'hit',(q>0).mean(),'turn',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 rr=[]; yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340428_volume_confirmed_residual20_signal.csv'); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340428_volume_confirmed_residual20_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().ffill(); lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Volatility-normalized 40d residual trend: medium trend divided by own 20d realized volatility.
res=r.sub(r.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
trend=res.rolling(40,min_periods=25).sum()
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
f=(trend/(vol*np.sqrt(40))).rank(axis=1,pct=True).sub(.5,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a,b=f.loc[dt],(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()

out=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=out.ic.dropna()

## Explored Factors

1. **Volume-confirmed residual trend 20d**
   - Computes 20-session cross-sectional residual log-return momentum.
   - Adjusts the trend using capped abnormal volume:
     \[
     \text{signal}=\text{residual trend}_{20}\times(1+0.35\times\text{capped volume shock}_{60})
     \]
   - Volume shock is based on log-volume relative to its 60-session rolling median.
   - Cross-sectionally ranked and lagged one session to avoid look-ahead bias.

2. **Volatility-normalized residual trend 40d**
   - Computes 40-session residual momentum normalized by 20-session realized volatility:
     \[
     \text{signal}=\frac{\text{residual trend}_{40}}{\text{realized volatility}_{20}\sqrt{40}}
     \]
   - Cross-sectionally ranked and lagged one session.

Both candidates used the 15 tradable benchmark instruments and a minimum of 8 valid instruments per daily IC observation.

## Validation Results

**Validation date:** 2034-04-28  
**Admission gates:** absolute 10-session IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840

| Factor | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | 10d IC | ICIR | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Volume-confirmed residual trend 20d | 4,378 | 9.00 | 59.98% | 0.022650 | 0.047819 | 8.45% | **Failed ICIR gate** |
| Volatility-normalized residual trend 40d | 4,383 | 15.00 | 99.99% | 0.017919 | 0.056333 | 6.04% | **Failed ICIR gate** |

### Volume-confirmed residual trend 20d

- 1-session IC: -0.010787; ICIR: -0.022715
- 5-session IC: 0.012289; ICIR: 0.026009
- 10-session IC: 0.022650; ICIR: 0.047819
- 20-session IC: 0.024723; ICIR: 0.051795
- Recent 120-session ICIR: 0.115215
- Recent 252-session ICIR: 0.030957
- Recent 756-session ICIR: 0.104944

The factor has positive full-history IC and encouraging recent 120- and 756-session behavior, but its full-history ICIR is below the required 0.0840 threshold. Coverage is also relatively weak because volume data are unavailable or invalid for several instruments.

### Volatility-normalized residual trend 40d

- 1-session IC: 0.001615; ICIR: 0.005063
- 5-session IC: 0.011018; ICIR: 0.034837
- 10-session IC: 0.017919; ICIR: 0.056333
- 20-session IC: 0.025951; ICIR: 0.080747
- Recent 120-session ICIR: 0.282464
- Recent 252-session ICIR: 0.085515
- Recent 756-session ICIR: 0.124437

This candidate has excellent coverage and lower turnover, with strong recent stability. However, the full-history 10-session ICIR remains below the admission threshold, so it is not yet effective.

## Persistence Actions

- No factors were persisted.
- Neither candidate passed both benchmark-wide admission gates.
- Research signal and IC artifacts were generated for auditability:
  - `scripts/miner_2_20340428_volume_confirmed_residual20_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20340428_volume_confirmed_residual20_ic.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20340428_volnorm_residual40_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20340428_volnorm_residual40_ic.csv`
- No live-account, backtest, or step actions were performed.

## Current Effective Factors

- **VIX-regime residual trend 20d**
  - 10-session IC: 0.031053
  - ICIR: 0.086666
  - Coverage: 99.993%
  - Turnover: 9.94%
  - Last validated: 2034-04-14
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**, pending deterministic library-correlation audit

## Plans

- Continue monitoring the effective VIX-regime residual trend factor, particularly its weaker long-window stability.
- Revisit volatility-normalized residual trend with regime conditioning or a longer forecast horizon, since its recent ICIR and 20-session performance are stronger than its full-history 10-session statistics.
- Explore independent defensive factors based on drawdown recovery, downside-risk asymmetry, or cross-asset dispersion while avoiding additional highly correlated residual-trend variants.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index().loc[:'2034-05-12'].ffill()
lp=np.log(P); r=lp.diff()
# Downside-adjusted recovery: medium trend is rewarded when recent losses are shallow,
# while a 60-session drawdown recovery term favors assets rebounding from a trough.
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(20,min_periods=12).std()
trend=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()
recovery=lp-lp.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min()
f=(trend/(down*np.sqrt(30)+1e-8)) + 0.25*(recovery/(r.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(60)+1e-8))
f=f.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rank(axis=1,pct=True).sub(.5,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]; b=(lp.shift(-10)-lp).loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,a[ok].corr(b[ok]),ok.sum()))
out=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=out.ic.dropna()
print('last_date',P.index.max(),'dates',len(q),'avgN',out.n.mean(),'coverage',out.n.mean()/15,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),'hit',(q>0).mean(),'turn',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for n in [120,252,756,1260]:
 x=q.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 rr=[]; yy=lp.shift(-h)-lp
 for dt in f.index:
  a,b=f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8 and a[ok].nunique()>1: rr.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok]))
 x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'obs',len(x))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340512_downside_recovery_signal.csv'); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340512_downside_recovery_ic.csv')
